targets.review_note: F(h) is optimal happiness of processed prefix when all its final heights are capped at h. For next (a,b), if h<=a set its height h: Fnew(h)=F(h)+b-a+h. If h>a either it stays invisible with value F(h), or becomes visible at a giving F(a)+b; take max. Lowering an invisible last person cannot improve value. F is monotone; right-hand chmax replaces a contiguous prefix by one constant. Compress all original heights, maintain F on those caps in a segment tree with affine coordinate-add and constant assignment. Search first point above the new constant using monotonicity. O(N log N), no need to enumerate heights or presume everyone must see the slide.
